# Reyes (2023) — Paraconformity and Erosive Amalgamation

Summary notes for the GEOL204 supplementary reading list.

## What does this paper actually claim?

Recovery of a succession above a [[Paraconformity]] is not a fixed dead interval but a continuous function of amalgamation frequency, and the rate at which [[Hummocky stratification]] rebuilds the storm record sets a floor on how fast that recovery curve can fall.

## Why is it on the GEOL204 reading list?

It is the cited source behind the lecture aside that preservation across the quiet interval depends on both erosive depth and rebuild rate, not erosive depth alone.

Citation: Reyes, T. (2023). Paraconformity and erosive amalgamation on storm-dominated shelves. *Journal of Sedimentary Geology*, 51(4), 88–101.
